title: FRAME CAP UP TO 240
why: His order of 2026-10-15: frame cap options above 60. The Frame cap setting now also offers 75, 90, 120, 144, 165 and 240 frames a second, after Off, 60 and 30, so a fast screen can be held to its own rate. The new choices sit at the end of the row so a cap already saved keeps meaning what it did.
now: The Frame cap setting now goes up to 75, 90, 120, 144, 165 and 240.
